subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill-creation authority/routing API for custom workflows before `skill_workshop`, or keep the current model where custom tools prepare proposal content and then call Skill Workshop directly?
rationale: The code already supports proposal content as a primitive, plugin tools, allowlists, and `before_tool_call`, but none of those choose a custom creation workflow before the model selects `skill_workshop`; adding that choice changes product/API boundaries and possibly config.

options.title: Design narrow authority API
options.body: Define a plugin-facing pre-selection or policy convention that can prioritize custom skill creators while keeping Skill Workshop as the only persistence and lifecycle mechanism.

options.title: Keep current model
options.body: Document that custom workflows must be exposed through ordinary tools/skills and call `skill_workshop` themselves, accepting that model routing may still choose the built-in tool first.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub conventions
options.body: Treat custom creation workflows as ClawHub skills/plugins only until a more concrete missing API is proven by additional implementations.

recommendation.title: Design narrow authority API
recommendation.body: Define a plugin-facing pre-selection or policy convention that can prioritize custom skill creators while keeping Skill Workshop as the only persistence and lifecycle mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the most recent related boundary decision in the merged direct-bypass fix and pointed separate bridge/API work back to this thread.
